description: This file defines the HibernatePersonDAO class, which implements data access methods for Person entities using Hibernate ORM. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching persons and related entities such as attributes and relationships within the OpenMRS healthcare system.

classes.name: HibernatePersonDAO
classes.description: Implementation of PersonDAO using Hibernate ORM, providing methods for CRUD operations and complex searches on Person entities.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Setter for the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database operations.

methods.name: setSearchSessionFactory
methods.description: Setter for the custom SearchSessionFactory used for search operations.

methods.name: executeSoundexOnePersonNameQuery
methods.description: Performs a search for persons based on a single name using soundex matching.

methods.name: executeSoundexThreePersonNamesQuery
methods.description: Performs a search for persons based on three names using soundex matching.

methods.name: executeSoundexTwoPersonNamesQuery
methods.description: Performs a search for persons based on two names using soundex matching.

methods.name: executeSoundexNPersonNamesQuery
methods.description: Performs a search for persons based on multiple names using soundex matching.

methods.name: getSimilarPeople
methods.description: Returns persons with names similar to the provided name, utilizing soundex-based searches for varying name parts.

methods.name: getPeople
methods.description: Retrieves persons matching a search string with optional filtering by dead or voided status; handles complex search scenarios including name and attribute-based queries.

methods.name: getMaximumSearchResults
methods.description: Fetches the maximum number of search results from global properties, with a default fallback.

methods.name: getPerson
methods.description: Retrieves a Person entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: deletePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a PersonAttributeType from the database.

methods.name: savePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a PersonAttributeType in the database.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getPersonAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getAllPersonAttributeTypes
methods.description: Fetches all PersonAttributeTypes, optionally including retired ones, ordered by sort weight.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypes
methods.description: Fetches PersonAttributeTypes based on various filters like name, format, foreign key, and searchable flag.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Retrieves a Relationship by its ID.

methods.name: getAllRelationships
methods.description: Fetches all Relationships, optionally including voided ones.

methods.name: getRelationships
methods.description: Fetches relationships matching specific person endpoints and relationship type; can include date filters.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Retrieves a RelationshipType by its ID.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypes
methods.description: Fetches relationship types based on name and preferred status.

methods.name: saveRelationshipType
methods.description: Saves or updates a RelationshipType.

methods.name: deleteRelationshipType
methods.description: Deletes a RelationshipType.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Deletes a Person entity from the database, including associated properties.

methods.name: savePerson
methods.description: Saves or updates a Person entity.

methods.name: saveRelationship
methods.description: Saves or updates a Relationship entity.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Deletes a Relationship entity.

methods.name: deletePersonAndAttributes
methods.description: Helper method to delete a Person and its associated addresses, attributes, and names.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a PersonAttributeType by its UUID.

methods.name: getSavedPersonAttributeTypeName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a PersonAttributeType using a raw SQL query.

methods.name: getSavedPersonAttributeTypeSearchable
methods.description: Checks if a PersonAttributeType is searchable using raw SQL.

methods.name: getPersonByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Person by UUID.

methods.name: getPersonAddressByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAddress by UUID.

methods.name: savePersonMergeLog
methods.description: Saves or updates a PersonMergeLog.

methods.name: getPersonMergeLog

methods.description: Retrieves a PersonMergeLog by UUID.

methods.name: getWinningPersonMergeLogs
methods.description: Fetches merge logs where a person was the winner.

methods.name: getLosingPersonMergeLogs
methods.description: Fetches a merge log where a person was the loser.

methods.name: getAllPersonMergeLogs
methods.description: Retrieves all PersonMergeLogs.

methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getPersonName

methods.description: Retrieves a PersonName by UUID.
